messages:
rachel: After last night's RBAC change we have multiple tenants with SCIM 403 and SSO logout not terminating sessions. Seeing KMS decrypt denies in the provisioner.

priay: (typo) priya: I pulled logs: 
``
ERROR: envelope decrypt failed: cloudkms: permission denied for cryptoKeyVersion projects/redwood/.../cryptoKeyVersions/7 tenant=delta-corp
```
Looks like alias moved during key rotation and the new version lacks SA binding.

tom: Quick mitigation: add roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to serviceAccount:scim-provisioner@redwood-infra on the new key version, then rewrap envelopes. Rolling back auth-proxy also fixed some SAML logout binding mismatches in canaries.

rachel: Plan: 1) Temporary IAM allow -> tom 2) Rewrap & rotate SCIM tokens -> priya 3) Audit KMS logs + vuln ticket -> rachel 4) Postmortem + rollout gating for key alias flips.

ops-bot: deploy:rollback auth-proxy triggered by tom -> v1.12.4 -> v1.12.3.

priya: After IAM binding, SCIM retries succeeded and OIDC introspect returned 200 for canaries. No plaintext tokens in logs. Opening vuln-triage and CS notification now.

rachel: Thanks. Action items recorded. Root cause: RBAC policy timing + alias swap during rotation + partial deploy ordering. Add guard to prevent alias flips until IAM binds propagate.
